study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individual deviations from normative electroencephalographic connectivity predict antidepressant response

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Three independent cohorts were used for healthy controls to build the normative model: (1) EMBARC (Establishing Moderators and Biosignatures of Antidepressant Response for Clinical Care), providing 8 HC (age <25 subset from 39 total HC) and 221 MDD patients; (2) Depression-EEG cohort, providing 75 HC; (3) LEMON (Leipzig Study for Mind-Body-Emotion Interactions), providing 71 HC (age <25 subset from 138 valid subjects). The EMBARC cohort also provided MDD patients (102 sertraline, 119 placebo) for treatment response prediction.

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The 154 healthy controls from three cohorts (EMBARC: 8, Depression-EEG: 75, LEMON: 71) were combined to build the normative model (autoencoder-based healthy norm). The MDD patients (N=221) from EMBARC were used for treatment response prediction, split into sertraline (n=102) and placebo (n=119) arms. The normative model was trained on all 154 HC; no separate train/test split is described for the normative model itself. Cross-validation (10-fold) was applied only at the prediction modeling stage on MDD patients.

These valid 221 patients were randomly assigned to a sertraline treatment arm (n = 102) and a placebo treatment arm (n = 119)"

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The study built one normative model using autoencoder (the primary model). PCA-based and regression-based models were also tested as comparisons using the same 154 HC. All 154 HC were used for training the normative model; no separate validation/test split is described for the normative model itself (cross-validation was only applied at the prediction modeling stage on MDD patients). Therefore overall-phase and train-phase are the same.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Supplementary Table 1 reports age for each HC cohort: EMBARC (N=8): mean=21.6, SD=2.8; Depression-EEG (N=75): mean=19.0, SD=1.2; LEMON (N=71): mean=22.5, SD=NA (age recorded at resolution of 5 years). Weighted mean across 154 HC = (8*21.6 + 75*19.0 + 71*22.5)/154 = 3195.3/154 = 20.75. Pooled SD could only be partially computed for EMBARC and Depression-EEG: sqrt(((8-1)*2.8^2 + (75-1)*1.2^2)/(8+75-2)) = sqrt(161.44/81) = 1.41; LEMON SD is not available so full pooled SD cannot be computed. Age range is 18-25 as stated: 'healthy norms of 154 young adults (age 18-25)'. All 154 HC were used for training (no separate train/test split for normative model), so overall-phase equals train-phase.
